summary.oneLiner: The deck positions S&S Power Switchgear as "a 60-year-old Indian company with significant international operations and presence, delivering high-end T&D and Industrial Automation solutions" — an Indian MNC in Power and Automation that reinvented itself from Feb 2024 through corporate restructuring and a new management team and is "now on a high-growth path".

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Group structure: S&S Power Switchgear Limited (BSE: 517273, NSE: S&SPOWER), headquartered in Chennai, with three fully owned subsidiaries — SSPSE (Chennai), Acrastyle (UK) and HART (Kolkata).
- SSPSE, established 1975, is described as "a pioneering High Voltage Disconnector manufacturer" with a five-decade legacy that has "deployed over 50,000 Disconnectors in 50 countries".
- Acrastyle Limited, established 1962 and based in Ulverston (UK), specialises in Protection and Control Panel solutions with "more than 25,000 units deployed globally"; acquired by S&S Power in 1995.
- HART (Hamilton Research & Technology Private Limited), established 1986 and acquired by S&S Power in 2024, delivers customised hardware and software solutions for aluminium plants worldwide (Pot Controllers, Heat Regulation Systems, Superheat Measurement Systems).
- Differentiation claimed on "superior customer service standards and in-depth engineering expertise", client-centricity and site-specific customisation, and built-to-suit retrofit solutions that "extend the lifespan of equipment" and lower customers' total cost of ownership.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Strategic KPI to "Pay a fair dividend to shareholders", progressed by "Share our success with Shareholders through proportional annual Dividends".
- Targets to "Generate positive free cash flow" by FY 2028 and, per the summary slide, "becoming debt-free, by Mar 2028".
- Plans to "Invest 1.0 – 1.25% of revenue into R&D" and to "Create strong IPRs (1-2x per company / year)".
- Working-capital discipline: "Work with secured payment terms, towards zero overdue payments" and "Focusing on profitable orders, streamlining PM, CM, and SCM functions (Fin. rigour)".
- People/retention: "Become an employer of choice to attract & retain talent", "Create modern work environments and nurture positive work culture, offer ESOPs".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Restructuring] "Starting Feb 2024, the company has reinvented itself, starting with corporate restructuring and inducting a new management team."
- [Acquisition] HART (Hamilton Research & Technology Private Limited) was acquired by S&S Power in 2024; Acrastyle was acquired in 1995.
- [Leadership] Krishnakumar Ramanathan is MD & Group CEO (30+ years, former CEO of Siemens Large Drives India); unit CEOs are N Balasubramanian (SSPSE), Nicholas Dunn (Acrastyle, eff. June'25) and Vikas Arora (HART); Ashish Jalan is Promoter & Chairman.
- [Framework] The "TOP+ framework": "Growth led by Technology, Powered by Ownership culture & supported by Processes, Plus a zero-deviation policy towards Quality, EHS, and Compliance."
- [Targets] FY 2026-2028 KPIs: "Doubling our organic revenues from FY 2025", "Improve EBIDA to 12 - 15%", and "Planning revenue growth at a CAGR of over 20% through Regular and Growth budgets".
